title: Three Tokens
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about gates that count. Tokens add to a counter, and a gate opens only when the counter can pay its price: three tokens for the first, and in the second the gate is the exit itself. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a price.

box.tagline: A gate can ask for three.
box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie finds purple tokens lying about. Each one adds to a count. The first gate takes three, so two are not enough. In the second room the gate is the way out. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a price.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Tokens add to a count, gates spend it
Made to be copied and taken apart
